code:
Confidentiality  Only authorized people can see the data
Integrity        Data is accurate, not tampered with
Availability     Authorized people can access it when needed
caption: Every security control exists to protect one or more of these three.

steps.label: Confidentiality — Equifax, 2017
steps.sub: unpatched app let attackers read 147M records; nothing changed or went offline

steps.label: Integrity — altered routing number
steps.sub: attacker edits a vendor's bank details; nothing stolen or taken down

steps.label: Availability — DDoS flood
steps.sub: junk traffic blocks real customers; nothing read or changed

eyebrow: Controls map back to the triad

steps.label: Access control & MFA
steps.sub: protect confidentiality AND integrity at once
